target_and_action_definitions.assembly_height_alignment: Move a complete connected object assembly relative to its support surface.
target_and_action_definitions.caster_axis_reorientation: Change the physical wheel/axle orientation, not just the chair yaw.
target_and_action_definitions.caster_geometry_revision: Change the shape/construction of actual caster wheels.
target_and_action_definitions.support_connector_geometry: Construct or revise a fork, axle, spoke or other structural connector.
target_and_action_definitions.evaluated_mesh_support_check: Student actually measures evaluated world-space component geometry to diagnose support.
target_and_action_definitions.local_floor_height_check: Student actually queries the support height below a local component.
target_and_action_definitions.mesh_distance_check: Student actually computes distances/intersections of component mesh surfaces.
target_and_action_definitions.side_view_inspection: Student actually produces/reads a side-view diagnostic, not an evaluator view.
target_and_action_definitions.top_view_inspection: Student actually produces/reads a top-view diagnostic.
target_and_action_definitions.fixed_camera_trial: Student holds the camera fixed across an actual comparison of other factors.
target_and_action_definitions.hinge_rotation_revision: Change a coherent leaf assembly around its hinge.
target_and_action_definitions.hinge_translation_revision: Change hinge/leaf assembly placement rather than swing alone.
target_and_action_definitions.doorway_geometry_revision: Change actual opening/frame geometry or its placement.
target_and_action_definitions.door_visibility_check: Student actually tests projected or occluded door visibility.
target_and_action_definitions.camera_revision: Actual camera edit followed by execution; not inherited old behavior.
target_and_action_definitions.lighting_revision: Actual light/world edit followed by execution.
target_and_action_definitions.material_binding_check: Student actually inspects which shader is bound to the target mesh.
target_and_action_definitions.procedural_noise_shader: Executed Noise/ColorRamp or related procedural material graph.
target_and_action_definitions.anisotropic_texture_mapping: Different texture scale/orientation along coordinate axes.
target_and_action_definitions.directional_texture_warp: Warp or distort texture coordinates for directional variation.
target_and_action_definitions.image_texture_material: A successfully loaded/bound image texture in an executed material.
target_and_action_definitions.procedural_texture_image_generation: Student actually generates an image asset for texture use.
target_and_action_definitions.roughness_hypothesis_trial: An executed material-roughness candidate, separated from color-pattern changes.
target_and_action_definitions.controlled_lighting_trial: Actual comparison under controlled/changed light to test highlight explanations.
target_and_action_definitions.candidate_comparison: Evidence of observing and comparing actual distinct candidates.
target_and_action_definitions.script_dependency_check: Actual inspection/check of code or image dependencies.
target_and_action_definitions.render_inspection: Student Read observes an actual generated render.
target_and_action_definitions.geometry_revision: Actual geometry edit and execution, with the specific method separately described.

rules: Vocabulary is a naming aid, not evidence of adoption.
Inherit code techniques only when retained/executed, never old conversation actions.
A failed attempt to load a missing image is not a successfully implemented image-texture material.
Posthoc evaluator measurements do not establish student actions.
New genuinely distinct semantic techniques may be added with evidence.
Scope target depends on the actual object and use; a generic primitive is not automatically a target capability.
